★ IDENTIFIED: Hickory Nuts. Hickory nut. Hard shell, sweet meat. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
🐺 HOWLS in the distance. Closer than before. The System chirps: "Oh! We made those! Are they... too many? We can make fewer?" (New monster: hushwolf pack.)
📖 LEARNED: Tripwire (Level 2). Barbed wire. The prone monster also bleeds.
Something out there knows exactly where you sleep. It isn't howling. That's the worst part — it isn't making a sound at all.
📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "We have studied cooking. Step one: apply heat until food stops being food? No — wait. We had it. Teach us? Show us one cooked meal, start to finish."

📖 LEARNED: Come Get Some (Level 1). Make exactly the right noise and the blind thing comes to investigate. Goad a blinded monster within 3 tiles: it lurches toward the sound on its next move. Stand where you want it.
📖 LEARNED: Scarecrow (Level 1). You can stage a fake injury to lure monsters into traps. They fall for it. Every time.

Fatima spends the afternoon with the twining vine in wet ground with brownish pea-flowers and strings of round tubers underground — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. Raw, it knots the stomach. Cooked... fine. The fire learns the rule before the name: cook it, or else.
★ Deeper knowledge: Hickory Nuts. Parts: nut meat (eat), shells (smoke flavor), bark (tea). Crack carefully. (Yield +50%). Use unlocked: food: sweet nutmeats — shell first, worth the work.
